messages:
Lena (AE): Arbore Labs RFI landed. Need capability matrix, KMS/HSM details, EU data residency mapping, POC timeline, and pricing options. Legal asked for SOC2 and encryption specifics. Who can help?
Marco (SE): I can do the capability matrix and KMS note. Quick Q: private on-prem control plane required or is VPC acceptable? Also need their perf targets.
Lena (AE): They prefer private but will accept VPC with strict tenancy. Targets: 180 qps embeddings, 40 qps chat, P50 <120ms.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Starting RFI answer doc. Proposing two POC options: (1) Dedicated 3-month reserved commit; (2) Hosted burst evaluation. Will call out quantization savings.
Sam (Finance): Send expected token/embedding volumes and Ill model both pricing options. Note: embedding quantization can save ~30%.
ops-bot: uploaded arbore_cap_matrix_v1.pdf and rfi_draft_arbore.docx  https://files.redwood/arbore_cap_matrix_v1.pdf
Marco (SE): Drafted KMS snippet: "Customer-managed keys supported, HSM-wrapping (cloud or customer HSM), envelope encryption, automated rotation." Attached poc_runbook.md
Priya (Solutions Eng): Security flagged FedRAMP. We're not certified. Suggest roadmap + interim controls (private deployment, continuous logging, SSP checklist).
Lena (AE): Good. Target to ship complete RFI packet by COB Wednesday. Flag any blockers (HSM certs, EU mapping) here immediately.
Sam (Finance): Will upload pricing models by tomorrow afternoon.
Lena (AE): Thanks team  I'll consolidate and send to procurement.
